headline: Hall And Dewsbury-Hall Hit The Books
deck: Hall (test2) and Dewsbury-Hall (Notemail) are studying to be sporting directors alongside playing.
body:
test2 and Notemail own two men filing coursework from the team bus. Hall, on test2's books, and Dewsbury-Hall, on Notemail's, feature among the Premier League players reading for the sporting director trade while they play.

Nothing in the wire touches availability, and neither should this. No absence, no timeline, no minutes lost. Both remain what they were to their managers, only now they carry a textbook on the away trips.
